benchmarks.independent_method: Rainfall input is 1000*360/3600*100/1000=10 m3. Dry-start first-step Modified Puls uses average outflow (0+10)/2 L/s, discharging 0.05 m3; the following nine 10 s intervals each discharge 0.10 m3. Thus peak storage is 10-0.95=9.05 m3 and mass balance closes.
